name: Sparxie
description:
Like! Follow! Stream! Views! Party till the world ends!
Sparxie and Sparkle, the Mask and the Fool are fundamentally the same.
Whoever is seen, whoever is liked, is the correct answer!

skills.name: Cat Got Your Flametongue?
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Sparxie's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Boom! Sparxicle's Poppin'
skills.desc: Start a livestream to turn Basic ATK into "Bloom! Winner Takes All" and trigger "Engagement Farming" 1 time. During this ability, "Engagement Farming" can be triggered repeatedly, up to #1[i] time(s). Using this ability is not considered as using a Skill.
skills.simpleDesc: Start a livestream to turn Basic ATK into "Bloom! Winner Takes All" and trigger "Engagement Farming" 1 time. "Engagement Farming" can be triggered repeatedly during this ability.

skills.name: Party's Wildin' and Camera's Rollin'
skills.desc: Gains #1[i] Punchline point(s). Deals Fire DMG equal to (#3[f1] × Elation + #2[f1]%) of Sparxie's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDesc: Gains Punchline. Deals Fire DMG to all enemies.

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

skills.name: Sleight of Sparx Hand
skills.desc:
While Sparxie holds "Certified Banger":
Using Enhanced Basic ATK deals #3[i]% Fire Elation DMG to one designated enemy, and #4[f1]% Fire Elation DMG to their adjacent targets. Additionally, for every 1 instance of "Engagement Farming" triggered, the Enhanced Basic ATK deals 1 extra instance of #1[f1]% Fire Elation DMG to 1 random attacked enemy target.
Using Ultimate deals #2[i]% Fire Elation DMG to all enemies.
skills.simpleDesc: While Sparxie holds "<u>Certified Banger</u>," using Enhanced Basic ATK or Ultimate deals Fire <u>Elation DMG</u> to enemies.

extra.name: Certified Banger
extra.desc:
Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.
Punchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.
The duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

extra.name: Elation DMG
extra.desc:
The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.
Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

skills.name: Content Monetization
skills.desc:
After using the Technique, inflicts enemies within a set area with "Block" for #3[i] second(s). "Blocked" enemies cannot detect ally targets.
After entering combat via actively attacking a "Blocked" enemy, deals Fire DMG to all enemies equal to #2[i]% of Sparxie's ATK and recovers #1[i] Skill Point(s) for allies.
skills.simpleDesc: Inflicts "Block" on all enemies within a set area. After entering combat via attacking a "Blocked" enemy, deals minor Fire DMG to all enemies and recovers Skill Points.

skills.name: Signal Overflow: The Great Encore!
skills.desc: Deals #2[f1]% Fire Elation DMG to all enemies and deals #3[i] additional instance(s) of DMG. Each instance deals #1[f1]% Fire Elation DMG to one random enemy. Grants #4[i] "Thrill" point(s) to Sparxie, which can be used to offset Sparxie's Skill Point consumption. Consuming "Thrill" is considered as consuming Skill Points.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals Fire Elation DMG to all enemies. Then, deals minor Fire Elation DMG to one enemy, bouncing #3[i] time(s). Gains "Thrill" that can offset Skill Point consumption.

extra.name: Elation DMG
extra.desc:
The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.
Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

eidolons.name: #GoingViral #WhoIsShe
eidolons.desc: When Aha Instant ends, gains 5 <u>Punchline</u>. For every 1 <u>Punchline</u> owned, increases All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> for all allies by 1.5%, up to a max increase of 15%.

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

extra.name: RES PEN
extra.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

eidolons.name: #AudienceKnows
eidolons.desc: When Aha Instant ends, Sparxie gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and 2 "Thrill." For every 1 "Thrill" consumed, increases this unit's CRIT DMG by 10%, lasting for 2 turn(s) and stacking up to 4 time(s).

extra.name: Extra Turn
extra.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

eidolons.name: #LinkUp #HeartSkip
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: #LockedIn #FaceCard
eidolons.desc: When using Ultimate, additionally gains 5 <u>Punchline</u> and increases this unit's Elation by 36% for 3 turn(s).

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

eidolons.name: #HealingTheWorld #GoodVibesOnly
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: #BuiltDifferent #GoingExtinct
eidolons.desc: Increases All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> by 20%. For every 1 <u>Punchline</u> taken into account, the number of additional DMG instances dealt by the Elation Skill increases by 1, up to a max of 40.

extra.name: RES PEN
extra.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

embedBonusSkill.name: Sweet! Punchline Signing
embedBonusSkill.desc: For every 100 of Sparxie's ATK that exceeds 2000, increases this unit's Elation by 5%, up to a maximum increase of 80%.

embedBonusSkill.name: Dazzling! Persona Kaleidoscope
embedBonusSkill.desc: When there are 1/2/≥3 Elation characters in the team, using Sparxie's Ultimate will additionally gain 2/4/8 <u>Punchline</u> and 1/1/4 "Thrill".

embedBonusSkill.name: Frenzy! Palette of Truth and Lies
embedBonusSkill.desc: For every 1 <u>Punchline</u> currently owned, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by 8%, up to a max increase of 80%.
